address: Main Street, Kenmare, V93 W35F, Ireland
bio: Having been a presence in Kenmare since 1995, this smart, warm restaurant has become a part of the town’s fabric, with plenty of the locals contributing to its lively atmosphere. Come for cocktails and snacks in the bar or settle in for the evening to enjoy a menu underpinned by local beef and seafood. The hearty dishes pack in plenty of flavour and are classic at heart, as evidenced by a terrific deconstructed version of a fish pie that shows off all the expected flavours via premium-quality seafood....
